alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 26 at 3:06PM CST by NWS Paducah KY
alerts.areaDesc: Fulton; Hickman; Carlisle; Perry; Bollinger; Cape Girardeau; Wayne; Carter; Ripley; Butler; Stoddard; Scott; Mississippi; New Madrid
alerts.description:
Temperatures will get down to around freezing tonight in
southeast Missouri and western portions of the Purchase region in
Kentucky. As rain comes to an end in these areas late tonight, the
potential for black ice will increase. Take precautions when
traveling especially on untreated roads, bridges, and overpasses.
